forbidden_gqe_bde_claim: Do not write 72.6→21.2 kcal/mol as a GQE number; that is classical UCCSD(T) in arXiv:2607.23988, not this labelled-ours B3LYP ΔBDE.
rule_documentation: Chemical next-ligand rule (used when the 6-D RBF GP is not fit or is too shaky to trust expected improvement): (1) pick CF3 if it is still unevaluated and no scored ligand is electron-withdrawing (n_F>0 or id=cf3); (2) else pick allyl if unevaluated (alkenyl radical stabilization after Sn–C cleavage); (3) else i-Pr, then n-Pr. Classical chemistry heuristic, not a GQE policy.
